verdict.rationale: A first-party public GitHub repository (nottelabs/notte) describes the agent/scripting framework, so some source appears readable. The evidence never states a license, and the hosted platform pieces (sessions, vaults, functions) are not shown to be open. One community comment wishing it were open source is a general question, not concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, clarity on which components are open vs. closed, independent confirmation of code availability.
